newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Stamford Tyres warehouse on fire.
newsitem.headline: Stamford Tyres warehouse on fire.

text.p: A warehouse belonging to Singapore's Stamford Tyres was hit by a large fire on Friday although there were no immediate reports of casualties, the civil defence office said.
Stamford Tyres did not answer phone calls to their office and eye witnesses reported heavy black smoke emerging from the site in the west of the city state.
"There was a fire there," one civil defence official said without further elaboration.
Singapore-based rubber dealers said some rubber may have been stored in the warehouse, but could not determine the exact volume involved.
"I think some rubber was stored there. It shouldn't have any impact in the local market," one dealer said.
